accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 2; Theorems 2--3; Proposition 2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Existence of fixed-radius, complete-observed-law alternatives that stay in every prescribed singular-margin shell is assumed only through the explicitly isolated legal same-shell deformation property.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The minimax-risk lower bound, honest-width lower bound, and necessity direction are claimed only conditional on a uniform affirmative resolution of the legal same-shell deformation property; the PCA and inversion upper bounds remain unconditional on nonempty shells.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines the APM, proves that single-super-cohort O3 convergence implies its null space is the factor column space, and derives fixed-T consistency/asymptotic linearity conditional on cohort-factor estimation assumptions.
For generic r-dimensional subspaces and r+1-coordinate projections, unique subspace identification holds iff every selected-column submatrix has at least its number of columns plus r nonzero rows.
